content.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not in an area of effect). In addition, if you roll a 20 for the save and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on you and instead targets the caster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

content.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries: While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.
